name: zethub-proof
description: ZetHub Proof — universal developer testing and verification platform

scripts.predev:api: npm run build -w @zethub/shared-types && npm run build -w @zethub/verification-core
scripts.build: npm run build -w @zethub/shared-types && npm run build -w @zethub/verification-core && npm run build -w @zethub/backend && npm run build -w @zethub/desktop && npm run build -w @zethub/browser-extension
scripts.pretypecheck: npm run build -w @zethub/shared-types && npm run build -w @zethub/verification-core
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @zethub/shared-types && npm run typecheck -w @zethub/verification-core && npm run typecheck -w @zethub/backend && npm run typecheck -w @zethub/desktop && npm run typecheck -w @zethub/browser-extension
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:security
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && playwright test -c tests/e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.predb:setup: npm run build -w @zethub/shared-types && npm run build -w @zethub/verification-core
scripts.predb:verify: npm run build -w @zethub/shared-types && npm run build -w @zethub/verification-core
scripts.predb:seed: npm run build -w @zethub/shared-types && npm run build -w @zethub/verification-core
